SpacetimeEvent.title: Relational spacetime event
SpacetimeEvent.statement: A spacetime event is a physical Fold transition located only by exact relations to generated recurrence clocks, spatial support and causal predecessor events.
SpacetimeEvent.generation_rule: Generate the complete event, causal-path, reference-frame, source/response, observation, target-access, successor and extra-rule product.
SpacetimeEvent.grammar_boundary: All finite spacetime and gravitational forms generated from exact event words, adjacent propagation, held orientation, recurrence clocks and complete source-bound relations without imported coordinates or continuum metric equations.

choices.name: answer-only-scalar
choices.reason: An answer-only scalar erases the generated physical carrier.

choices.name: complete-fold-carrier
choices.reason: The complete Fold trace retains the observed physical distinction.

choices.name: imported-or-fitted-relation
choices.reason: An imported or fitted relation lets consensus or target data select the law.

choices.name: event-as-clock-space-causal-relation
choices.reason: Complete relational coordinates retain every operational distinction without assuming an external background manifold.

choices.name: unbound-provenance
choices.reason: Unbound provenance cannot demonstrate which premises produced the result.

choices.name: source-bound-proof-trace
choices.reason: Every generated candidate and decision is bound to its exact source trace.

choices.name: target-readable-prediction
choices.reason: A target-readable predictor can copy or optimize against the measurement.

choices.name: capability-closed-prediction

choices.name: proof-measurement-conflation
choices.reason: Treating an external decimal record as a proof scalar violates the measured-value boundary.

choices.name: separate-measurement-record
choices.reason: External values remain source-bound records compared only after sealing.

choices.name: selected-favourable-rows
choices.reason: Selecting favorable rows cannot falsify the relation.

choices.name: complete-registered-rows
choices.reason: Every favorable, unfavorable and tampered registered row is retained.

choices.name: finite-answer-lookup
choices.reason: An answer lookup has no successor certificate.

choices.name: one-successor-closure
choices.reason: The One base and generated successor preserve the relation at every declared finite depth.

choices.name: free-extra-rule
choices.reason: A free constant, scale or exception can select the measured answer.

choices.name: no-extra-rule
choices.reason: No rule beyond the admitted dependencies and forced relation is present.

SpacetimeEvent.exact_result: A physical spacetime event is a source-bound transition with exact clock, spatial and causal relations.
SpacetimeEvent.induction_base: One event is one generated state transition with one held recurrence count, spatial relation and causal predecessor trace.
SpacetimeEvent.induction_step: Adding one event preserves every prior event, interval, causal and source relation and appends exactly its generated adjacent paths and observation records.
exclusions: ungenerated spacetime continuum or completed infinity
floating, irrational, imaginary or signed proof magnitude
imported metric equation, fitted curvature or target-selected constant
target access, omitted detector row or unrecorded causal predecessor
operational_witnesses: Every event retains state, recurrence and causal predecessor identity.
Every response has a generated adjacent path from its source.

target_rows.source_locator: GWOSC source and detector event identities

SpacetimeEvent.falsification_condition: The spacetime/gravity law is falsified if a committed external row lacks the sealed event/causal/source relation, a row is omitted, or the tampered row is accepted.
